text: Testing plays a key role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, such as a single function, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of the system work together. Many developers also use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them plan better and avoid mistakes. Good testing gives developers confidence. When tests pass, the team knows that changes haven't broken anything important. Although writing tests takes time, it saves much more time later by finding problems early.
